+# `@version` suffix means they resolve to the latest registry release
+# whenever a sync actually runs. To pin, append a version
+# (e.g. `Google@1.0.0`).
+#
+# In CI that is NOT every run: `ci.yml` caches the pack directories keyed on
+# a hash of THIS FILE and skips `vale sync` on an exact hit, so the packs a
+# workflow uses are the ones resolved the last time this line changed. That
+# is deliberate. An unpinned pack re-resolved on every run can turn a
+# previously green CI red with no change to the repository, which is a worse
+# failure than slightly old rules — and it strikes hardest on `main`, where
+# nothing was even edited. Bumping the packs is therefore an edit to this
+# line: change it (or the cache key's `v1-` prefix in `ci.yml`) and the next
+# run re-syncs. Locally, `vale sync` is unconditional and always resolves
+# latest.
